about: The wolf feeding (GRAZE in docs/design/HUNTING.md section 2, the head-down steps): four poses of the body's own Graze, played by time: the muzzle at the ground in front of the splayed forepaws, a pull back with the head turned, a second bite a little to the other side, and a chew made with the head bone (there is no jaw). Frames 0 and 12 (the bite and the pull) are a loop of two on their own, for a graze of two poses. GRAZE's head-up beat (2 steps at full sight) is the standing head of Idle's first pose, not this clip and not Alert, so it does not read as the alert's tell.
